title: Untitled (Three Discs, Quiet)
description: Three silver compact discs—one small in the upper right, one medium at mid-left, one large at center-lower—are arranged across an aged white ground bearing stain marks and edge perforations. Below the largest disc, a small technical drawing of a top-view aircraft appears above a red horizontal band at the bottom margin.
composition: diagonal disc descent on near-empty field
